name: Four-Week Running Meditation Transfer
description:
Standalone 4-week running meditation overlay aligned to the Four-Week Running Calibration — Patched routine. It does not alter mileage, intensity, HR calibration, strides, drills, steady checks, long runs, or diagnostic testing. Its purpose is to transfer seated meditation skills into running by reducing adversarial rumination and improving sensory presence during easy, recovery, and long runs.

Source running bundle: Four-Week Running Calibration — Patched (four-week-running-calibration-patched), routine four-week-running-calibration-patched-routine, 2026-06-29 to 2026-07-26, relationship overlay_only_no_running_load_changes.

Primary goal: Notice adversarial rumination earlier during runs and disengage without completing the imaginary argument.

Success condition: Argument loops may still appear, but they are noticed earlier, completed less often, shorter in duration, and lower in emotional charge.

Default anchors: foot strike, breath rhythm, arm swing, visual field, ambient sound, whole-body running sensation.

Default labels: arguing, rehearsing, planning, remembering, judging, thinking, body, sound, effort.

Metric specs: argument_loop_count: Argument-loop count; longest_loop_duration: Longest loop duration; detection_speed (1-5): Detection speed; disengagement_success (1-5): Disengagement success; emotional_charge (1-5): Emotional charge; present_moment_fraction: Present-moment fraction; post_run_clarity (1-5): Post-run mental clarity; practice_interference (0-5): Practice interference with running execution.

Analysis notes: Treat Day 1 as a non-intervention baseline mental drift audit. Treat Day 22 as a within-run split test between natural mind and deliberate noting. Use long-run overlays on Days 6, 13, 20, and 27 to assess transfer under longer duration. Do not compare diagnostic-day mental metrics against easy-day metrics. If practice_interference is high on any run, reduce the next overlay duration rather than forcing the protocol.

card_templates.name: Pre-Run Intention
card_templates.summary: Brief intention that primes one running anchor and one rumination-interruption rule.

payload.instructions: 1-minute setup. Before starting the run, choose one anchor. If adversarial rumination appears, label it once and return to the anchor.

items.label: Choose anchor
items.detail: Foot strike, breath rhythm, arm swing, visual field, or ambient sound.

items.label: Set rule
items.detail: Do not finish imaginary arguments during the run.

card_templates.name: Baseline Mental Drift Audit
card_templates.summary: Non-intervention baseline: observe how much rumination appears during a normal easy run.

payload.instructions: 2-minute review. Do not try to control thoughts during the run. Afterward, log how much adversarial rumination happened and how sticky it felt.

card_templates.name: Anchor + Noting Block
card_templates.summary: Time-boxed running meditation block using one sensory anchor and light labels for sticky thought loops.

payload.instructions: During the assigned block, rest attention on the chosen anchor. When an argument loop appears, label it once and return. Do not finish the argument. Success condition: Notice the loop before completing it.

exercises.label: Choose one anchor
exercises.detail: foot strike, breath rhythm, arm swing, visual field, ambient sound

exercises.label: Return to sensory running
exercises.detail: Do not finish the imaginary argument.

exercises.label: Watch failure modes
exercises.detail: winning the imaginary debate before returning; analyzing why the thought appeared; turning the run into a forced concentration exercise

exercises.label: Post-run log
exercises.detail: Argument-loop count: 0 / 1-2 / 3-5 / 6+; Longest argument-loop duration: none / <30s / 30s-2min / 2-5min / 5min+; Detection speed: 1-5; Disengagement success: 1-5; Emotional charge: 1-5; Present-moment fraction: <25% / 25-50% / 50-75% / 75%+; Post-run mental clarity: 1-5; Primary trigger, if obvious; Most useful anchor or label

card_templates.name: Open Awareness Run Block
card_templates.summary: Open-field awareness during easy or recovery running with body contact as fallback.

payload.instructions: Let sounds, body sensations, breath, and thoughts come and go. Use labels only when attention gets captured. Return to the moving body. Success condition: Experience remains broad; sticky thought episodes dissolve without being completed.

exercises.label: Open field awareness
exercises.detail: Let sounds, body sensations, breath, and thoughts come and go.

exercises.label: Label only when captured
exercises.detail: Use labels only when attention gets sticky.

exercises.label: Post-run log
exercises.detail: Argument-loop count: 0 / 1-2 / 3-5 / 6+; Longest argument-loop duration: none / <30s / 30s-2min / 2-5min / 5min+; Detection speed: 1-5; Disengagement success: 1-5; Emotional charge: 1-5; Present-moment fraction: <25% / 25-50% / 50-75% / 75%+; Post-run mental clarity: 1-5; Primary trigger, if obvious; Most useful anchor or label

card_templates.name: Long Run Three-Phase Awareness
card_templates.summary: Structured long-run overlay: settle, rumination noting block, and late-run fatigue awareness.

payload.instructions: Use the listed running-meditation cues during the assigned run. Success condition: Longer run creates more mental space, but argument loops are noticed and released earlier.

exercises.label: Settle
exercises.detail: First 20 min: breath/cadence only. Do not force meditation.

exercises.label: Transfer block
exercises.detail: Middle block: label argument loops and return to sensory running.

exercises.label: Fatigue awareness
exercises.detail: Final 10-20 min: notice effort, boredom, drift, or desire to push without story-building.

exercises.label: Post-run log
exercises.detail: Argument-loop count: 0 / 1-2 / 3-5 / 6+; Longest argument-loop duration: none / <30s / 30s-2min / 2-5min / 5min+; Detection speed: 1-5; Disengagement success: 1-5; Emotional charge: 1-5; Present-moment fraction: <25% / 25-50% / 50-75% / 75%+; Post-run mental clarity: 1-5; Primary trigger, if obvious; Most useful anchor or label

card_templates.name: Mechanics Cue Only
card_templates.summary: Minimal cueing for stride and drill days; no scored rumination experiment during fast or technical work.

payload.instructions: During strides or drills, use only simple mechanics cues. Do not score open monitoring during fast or technical segments. Success condition: Fast or technical work stays clean and relaxed without adding cognitive load.

card_templates.name: Effort-Sensation Anchor
card_templates.summary: Steady/progression-day overlay that uses breath, posture, and effort pressure rather than elaborate thought noting.

payload.instructions: During steady or progression segments, keep attention on controlled effort. Label only obvious argument loops; otherwise prioritize execution. Success condition: Effort remains controlled and non-dramatic.

card_templates.name: Diagnostic Day Execution Only
card_templates.summary: No meditation experiment during the LTHR diagnostic; use execution cues only.

payload.instructions: Use execution cues only. Do not run a meditation-transfer experiment during the diagnostic test portion. Success condition: The diagnostic remains clean and controlled, or is skipped when readiness is not good.

card_templates.summary: Within-run comparison: natural mind first, anchor + noting second.

payload.instructions: Compare how much argument rumination happens naturally versus during deliberate noting. Keep pace and effort unchanged.

exercises.label: Natural mind
exercises.detail: Let the mind behave normally. Do not intentionally intervene.

exercises.label: Anchor + noting
exercises.detail: Use the chosen anchor; label argument loops and return.

exercises.label: Post-run log
exercises.detail: Argument-loop count: 0 / 1-2 / 3-5 / 6+; Longest argument-loop duration: none / <30s / 30s-2min / 2-5min / 5min+; Detection speed: 1-5; Disengagement success: 1-5; Emotional charge: 1-5; Present-moment fraction: <25% / 25-50% / 50-75% / 75%+; Post-run mental clarity: 1-5; Primary trigger, if obvious; Most useful anchor or label; Natural-mind phase loop count; Noting phase loop count

card_templates.name: Weekly Running Meditation Review
card_templates.summary: Weekly review of rumination frequency, loop stickiness, disengagement, and useful anchors.

payload.instructions: 5-minute review. Review mental-practice signal separately from running fitness. Identify what reduced argument-loop stickiness.

items.label: Which run type triggered the most argument loops?
Was the label "arguing" early enough, or did you label too late?
Did loops become shorter or less emotionally charged?
Did the practice interfere with running execution?

routine_specs.name: Four-Week Running Meditation Transfer
routine_specs.notes: Overlay routine aligned to the running calibration plan. It does not change mileage or intensity. It adds mental-practice instructions and metrics for adversarial rumination during runs. Depends on running routine four-week-running-calibration-patched-routine; this bundle is an overlay and does not change the running plan. Design rules: Do not alter prescribed running distance, duration, RPE, workout type, or calibration instructions. Use scored running meditation mainly on easy, recovery, and long runs. Do not score meditation during strides, drills, or the LTHR diagnostic portion; use simple execution cues instead. Separate running-meditation metrics from running performance and HR calibration metrics. The goal is not blank mind. The goal is earlier detection and non-completion of adversarial thought loops.

prescription_override_json.title: Baseline mental drift audit
prescription_override_json.instructions: Do not intervene during the run. Afterward, log how much argument-rumination happened naturally.

prescription_override_json.title: Stride-day mechanics cue
prescription_override_json.instructions: During the easy portion, use 5 minutes of foot-strike anchoring. During strides, use only tall / relaxed / quick.

prescription_override_json.title: 10-minute anchor + noting block
prescription_override_json.instructions: Run easy. For 10 minutes, use foot strike or breath as anchor; label argument loops and return.

prescription_override_json.title: 15-minute arguing → return block
prescription_override_json.instructions: For 15 minutes, label adversarial thought as arguing and return to sensory running.

prescription_override_json.title: Drill-day mechanics cue
prescription_override_json.instructions: Use relaxed sensory presence during the easy run. During drills, use only crisp mechanics cues.

prescription_override_json.title: Long-run three-phase awareness
prescription_override_json.instructions: First 20 minutes settle; middle 20 minutes noting; final 10-20 minutes fatigue awareness without story-building.

prescription_override_json.title: Recovery open-awareness run
prescription_override_json.instructions: Use 10 minutes of soft open awareness. Let thoughts pass; label only sticky argument loops.

prescription_override_json.title: Week 1 running meditation review
prescription_override_json.instructions: Review mental-practice signal separately from running performance and HR calibration.
review_fields: Whether practice interfered with running execution

prescription_override_json.title: 20-minute anchor + noting block
prescription_override_json.instructions: Use a 20-minute scored block. Keep effort and pace unchanged.

prescription_override_json.title: Stride-day pre-stride anchor
prescription_override_json.instructions: Use 10 minutes of foot-strike anchor before strides. Do not score meditation during strides.

prescription_override_json.title: 20-minute open-awareness recovery run
prescription_override_json.instructions: Use broad awareness during recovery running. Body sensation is fallback anchor.

prescription_override_json.title: Progression-day effort anchor
prescription_override_json.instructions: During easy portion, use anchor + noting. During steady finish, use breath/posture/effort as anchor.

prescription_override_json.title: 10-minute visual-field anchor
prescription_override_json.instructions: Use visual field as anchor during the easy portion. During drills, use mechanics cues only.

prescription_override_json.title: Long-run 2x20 awareness blocks
prescription_override_json.instructions: Use two 20-minute blocks: one middle-run noting block and one late-run fatigue-awareness block.

prescription_override_json.title: Recovery awareness + review prep
prescription_override_json.instructions: Use 10 minutes soft open awareness, then log weekly rumination patterns after the run.

prescription_override_json.title: Week 2 running meditation review
prescription_override_json.instructions: Review mental-practice signal separately from running performance and HR calibration.
review_fields: Whether practice interfered with running execution

prescription_override_json.title: 20-minute argument-loop noting
prescription_override_json.instructions: Use 20 minutes focused on early detection of arguing and non-completion.

prescription_override_json.title: Stride-day anchor only
prescription_override_json.instructions: Use 10 minutes pre-stride anchor. Strides remain mechanics-only.

prescription_override_json.title: 20-minute recovery open awareness
prescription_override_json.instructions: Use broad open awareness. Label only sticky loops and return to whole-body running.

prescription_override_json.title: LTHR diagnostic execution only
prescription_override_json.instructions: No meditation experiment during the diagnostic. Use controlled / even / do not race cues only.

prescription_override_json.title: Conditional post-test anchor block
prescription_override_json.instructions: If LTHR test was completed, use 10 minutes soft anchor only. If skipped, use 20 minutes anchor + noting.

prescription_override_json.title: 30-minute long-run transfer block
prescription_override_json.instructions: Use one continuous 30-minute transfer block in the middle of the long run.

prescription_override_json.title: Recovery awareness + review prep
prescription_override_json.instructions: Use 10 minutes recovery awareness. Keep it gentle after the highest-load week.

prescription_override_json.title: Week 3 running meditation review
prescription_override_json.instructions: Review mental-practice signal separately from running performance and HR calibration.
review_fields: Whether practice interfered with running execution

prescription_override_json.title: Natural mind vs noting split test
prescription_override_json.instructions: First 15 minutes natural mind; next 20 minutes anchor + noting. Compare loop count and stickiness.

prescription_override_json.title: Light-stride mechanics cue
prescription_override_json.instructions: Use 10 minutes anchor before strides. Reduced stride dose remains mechanics-only.

prescription_override_json.title: 20-minute open monitoring run
prescription_override_json.instructions: Use 20 minutes open monitoring during recovery running. Body contact is fallback.

prescription_override_json.title: Short steady check effort anchor
prescription_override_json.instructions: Use noting during easy portions. During steady block, use breathing/posture/controlled-effort anchor only.

prescription_override_json.title: 20-minute relaxed visual-field anchor
prescription_override_json.instructions: Use visual field or ambient sound as anchor for 20 minutes. Keep effort easy.

prescription_override_json.title: Final 30-minute transfer assessment
prescription_override_json.instructions: Use final 30-minute transfer assessment. Track loop count, detection speed, and emotional charge.

prescription_override_json.title: Final recovery awareness
prescription_override_json.instructions: Use easy awareness and keep the run soft. Prepare final 4-week review after.

prescription_override_json.title: Week 4 running meditation review
prescription_override_json.instructions: Review mental-practice signal separately from running performance and HR calibration.
review_fields: Whether practice interfered with running execution
